subject: Decision Forum — post-demo recap, buyer map & procurement checklist
messages:
From: Dylan Brooks <dylan@redwood.com>
To: Asha Patel <asha@finservco.com>, Tom Reynolds <tom.reynolds@finservco.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 19 Jan 2028 09:15:00 -0800
Subject: Decision Forum — post-demo recap, buyer map & procurement checklist

Hi Asha / Tom — thanks again for taking the demo this morning. Quick recap and proposed next steps from our side so the Decision Forum (steering group) can be productive: 

1) Recap (2 min) — what we showed: low-latency inference on your 2k qps peak path, prefix caching for your customer chat flows, and our rollout/fallback plan for multi-region.

2) Stakeholder map (action) — I sketched an initial buyer map below and want to confirm names before we invite the Decision Forum:
   - Economic buyer: Asha Patel (Head of Digital Products) — responsible for go/no-go on TCO and roadmap alignment
   - Security owner: Tom Reynolds (Infosec) — primary gate for SOC2 + SSO/KMS integration
   - Procurement contact: procurement@finservco.com — contract + SLAs
   - Platform/Infra: (TBD) — recommended they include someone who owns deployment/runbook decisions

3) Procurement & security gates I need from you before the forum:
   - SOC2 scan summary or attestation (if available)
   - A list of required contract clauses (e.g., data residency, indemnity caps)
   - Any procurement timeline constraints (PO lead times, legal review windows)

4) Proposed Decision Forum agenda (30 min):
   - 5 min: Goals and timeline (Asha)
   - 10 min: Demo highlights and performance summary (Dylan)
   - 10 min: Security/procurement questions + path to signature (Tom + procurement)
   - 5 min: Decision & owners (confirm next steps)

Attachments: I attached the demo deck (PDF) and a short security evidence index spreadsheet — these are intentionally high level for steering.

Can you confirm: (A) the Decision Forum attendee list (by EOD Monday), and (B) whether procurement prefers a SOW + PO approach or a master services agreement?

If helpful, Monica and Ben from our team are available to join the Decision Forum to answer pricing and technical runbook questions.

Thanks,

Dylan Brooks
Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference
D: +1 (415) 555-0123 | dylan@redwood.com

--- Attachment(s): 2028-01-19-finservco-demo-deck.pdf (application/pdf), security-evidence-index.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet)
From: Asha Patel <asha@finservco.com>
To: Dylan Brooks <dylan@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>
Cc: Tom Reynolds <tom.reynolds@finservco.com>, Procurement Team <procurement@finservco.com>
Date: Thu, 19 Jan 2028 11:02:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Decision Forum — post-demo recap, buyer map & procurement checklist

Thanks Dylan — that was a crisp demo and helpful framing. Quick answers and additions: 

- Confirming Economic buyer = me. I’ll chair the Decision Forum on behalf of Product.
- I’ll loop in Raj (Legal) and Priya (Cloud Ops) to the invite — Raj will own contract redlines and Priya will speak to deployment constraints.
- Procurement prefers MSA + SOW; they asked to see standard SLAs and any standard indemnity language up front.
- For SOC2 we have a summary report but it’s vendor-managed; we can share the SOC2 Type II attestation under NDA.

Action items for us (Asha):
- Share full attendee list by Monday EOD (I’ll confirm Raj & Priya)
- Procurement to share any target contract terms by next Wednesday

Can you also add a short slide to the deck that shows expected per-token unit economics at 2k qps and a fallback-cost example? That will help our CFO and procurement when they review TCO.

Appreciate it — Asha

Asha Patel
Head of Digital Products | FinServCo
asha@finservco.com | +1 (617) 555-2199
From: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
To: Asha Patel <asha@finservco.com>, Dylan Brooks <dylan@redwood.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>, Procurement Team <procurement@finservco.com>
Date: Fri, 20 Jan 2028 08:40:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Decision Forum — post-demo recap, buyer map & procurement checklist

Thanks Asha — flagged. A couple of items from our side so the Decision Forum isn’t blocked: 

- Security artifacts we can provide immediately (under NDA): SOC2 Type II summary, penetration test overview, and our data handling whitepaper. I attached a short index (security-evidence-index.xlsx) with expected timelines for the deeper artifacts.
- For procurement: we generally propose an MSA + SOW for enterprise deals. Typical SLA ask: 99.9% runtime SLA on dedicated pools; we can add an optional premium for 99.95%.
- Pricing: Dylan — I’ll prepare token-level examples across three traffic shapes (steady chat, bursty support, and nightly batch embedding) and include a fallback-cost scenario for model downgrade. Expect that by Mon EOD.

Notes on attendees — recommend adding: Lauren Bishop (Solutions) for runbook and rollout sequencing, and Monica for commercial. Lauren, Monica — can you confirm availability for the Decision Forum window next Wed 30 mins between 10am-2pm PT?

Ben Carter
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
ben@redwood.com | +1 (650) 555-3344
From: Lauren Bishop <lauren@redwood.com>
To: Asha Patel <asha@finservco.com>, Dylan Brooks <dylan@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>, Procurement Team <procurement@finservco.com>
Date: Tue, 24 Jan 2028 11:05:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Decision Forum — post-demo recap, buyer map & procurement checklist

Hi all — thanks for the quick turn. Asha — confirmed for next Wednesday 30 min slot. I sent a calendar invite to the list and attached two artifacts: a one-page rollout checklist and a short runbook excerpt showing integration points for SSO/KMS and the recommended canary cadence.

I also included a DocuSign link for a standard NDA that will unlock the SOC2 Type II attestation share (DocuSign: https://www.docusign.com/requests/example-docusign-id). 

Final ask before the Decision Forum: could FinServCo share any procurement playbook constraints (e.g., PO lead time, required invoicing language) so Legal and Procurement can do a quick readiness pass? If you prefer, procurement can share a short form they commonly use and we’ll map it to our standard MSA terms ahead of the meeting.

Thanks — looking forward.

Lauren Bishop
Solutions Architect | Redwood Inference
lauren@redwood.com | +1 (408) 555-4488
